subject: UK Addendum rollout: subscriber notice, timeline, and checkpoints
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: UK Addendum rollout: subscriber notice, timeline, and checkpoints

Hi all —

Putting this thread together to align on our UK Addendum rollout plan for customers in the coming quarter, starting with Aurelia Health (cc'd). Key asks: a short subscriber notice for customers, a confirmed timeline for DocuSign circulation, and a final checklist of evidence we need to share (logs, subprocessors map, any TIAs).

Attached: UK_Addendum_Diff.docx — redlines between current DPA and proposed UK Addendum.

Questions I want us to close this week:
- Do we require customer re-consent (simple notice vs. signature) for this cohort?
- Procurement / legal: what evidence bundle do we hand to customers vs. upload to a secure drive?
- Sales: acceptable rollout window (2–4 weeks after circulation)?

Plan proposal (high level):
1) Finalize subscriber notice draft (legal) — 2 business days
2) Send to customers as a short notice + optional signature via DocuSign (ops/procurement) — 7 business days
3) Provide evidence bundle link and support call (support/CS) — concurrent with circulation

Please mark any blockers.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Legal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: UK_Addendum_Diff.docx (docx, 45KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: UK Addendum rollout: subscriber notice, timeline, and checkpoints

On Sat, Jul 19, 2025 at 9:12 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi all —
> 
> Putting this thread together to align on our UK Addendum rollout plan for customers in the coming quarter...

Thanks Kim — clear framing. A few practical notes from the DPA/evidence side:

- Evidence bundle: procurement teams typically want an index.csv + PDFs. Recommend we stage: 1) redline (done), 2) SOC2 summary, 3) subprocessor map (current snapshot), 4) data routing diagram, 5) TIA summary (if applicable). I can assemble the SOC2 summary and index.
- Re-consent vs notice: legal should recommend the default. If we can get a signature on the UK Addendum via DocuSign that reduces churn risk but increases friction. For enterprise customers (Aurelia falls into enterprise), we should aim for signed addendum. For smaller orgs, notice-only.
- DocuSign: I'd coordinate with Sales to ensure signed envelopes do not block go-live; we can allow conditional activation (customer in trial mode until envelope complete).

If Sales can commit to a 10-business-day window from circulation to complete signed addendum for Aurelia, procurement will be comfortable. Jordan — can you confirm?

Marissa
Sr. Contracts Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@aureliahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: UK Addendum rollout: subscriber notice, timeline, and checkpoints

Thanks for the overview, Kimberly — appreciate the clear steps. A couple quick items from Aurelia's side:

- We prefer a one-page customer-facing notice followed by a single DocuSign envelope for signature.
- Procurement needs to see the evidence bundle before routing to our legal (index is helpful). Can you provide a shared drive link and a small summary of what will be pasted into our procurement system?
- Does Redwood expect existing customers to reconsent if they already signed the DPA? If the change is material, we'll require a signature; if it's purely clarifying routing, notice is acceptable.

We can meet next Tue to review the final notice and envelope if that helps.

Best,
Sarah Wells
Head of Procurement
Aurelia Health

Kimberly / Marissa —

Sales can commit to a 10-business-day signature window for Aurelia. Two asks from my side:
1) Can Product confirm there are no routing changes that would impact Aurelia's region during the rollout? If there are infra-side flags, we need to coordinate activation.
2) Naomi — can you own the customer comms cadence (initial notice, two reminders, final confirmation)? I will be the sales owner on the envelope.

If Product signs off today, we can target circulation on Mon, Jul 21 with a target complete date of Aug 4.

Team — thanks for the quick turn. Summary and agreed next steps: 

Decisions:
- Aurelia: signed addendum via DocuSign (sales to manage the envelope).
- Evidence bundle: index + SOC2 summary + subprocessor map + routing diagram + TIA summary. Marissa will compile index & SOC2 summary; Naomi will upload to a shared Drive link.
- Timeline: circulation Mon, Jul 21; customer signature target Aug 4 (10 business days).
- Activation: conditional activation allowed — product to toggle routing on signed-confirmation.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Marissa: finalize evidence index and SOC2 summary (ETA: Mon, Jul 21 EOD).
- Naomi: create Drive folder, upload bundle, and share link with Aurelia + include short procurement blurb (ETA: Mon, Jul 21 10:00 PT).
- Jordan: send DocuSign envelope and manage reminders (ETA: Mon, Jul 21 morning).
- Kimberly: finalize subscriber_notice_draft.pdf and confirm whether we put the notice in the envelope or send as separate notice (ETA: Mon, Jul 21 AM).

Links / attachments:
- Drive: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C4_subscriber_notice (subscriber notice draft & audit trail)
- DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/organizations/REDWOOD/envelopes/0A1B2C

Files attached: subscriber_notice_draft.pdf (pdf, 12KB) — this is the one-page notice draft.
